summary: Biophytis SA filed a Form 6-K reporting provisional financial results for fiscal year 2025 and providing a strategic outlook. The filing updates progress on a Hong Kong joint venture for BIO101 in sarcopenia, regulatory approvals, and an AI-drug discovery partnership. There are no specific deal terms involving a price per share, premium, or stake. No transaction triggering a special situation classification is announced. This is a routine business update by a foreign private issuer.
